frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: That was amazing! I can feel the evil hum lessen on our planet. I think you scared him off!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thanks Moxie! Now you are free to groove without hesitation!

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: Here is the Celestial Amp, use it wisely.

frames.heading: Celestial Amp
frames.body: In the vibrant world of Funkopolis, where groovy beats and soulful rhythms flow through every street, the Celestial Amp is a legendary artifact of immense musical power. Infused with the essence of delicious basslines, it amplifies grooves with the planet's infectious rhythms. This amplifier transforms simple tunes into electrifying funk symphonies!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Let's go to the Grand Composer's new planet! We have enough power to defeat him once and for all...

frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: But how will you fly there? The space junk has blocked your exit!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Player, we can use the Boulder power to destroy the junk with ease!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Brilliant, Mojo! Let's remove this evil junk from the atmosphere.
